about: Saint-Charles-Borromée is a city in Lanaudière, Quebec, immediately beside Joliette on the L’Assomption River corridor. Residential neighbourhoods and local services form a distinct municipality within the Joliette urban area rather than a remote countryside town. Regional roads and transit link it to Montréal’s North Shore orbit. About 15,000 people live in Saint-Charles-Borromée.
